project.generic_integrator_prompt: Use $todo-orchestrator and continue. Claim only an integration task. Reconcile all prerequisite handoffs and interface hashes, acquire every recorded public-API/CMake/external-repository/integration lock, run guard and changes before shared seams, and use the exact recorded gates. invariants.rule: Baseplane SQLite state is the only BitOp operational authority. state.snapshot.json and Markdown are generated projections; never hand-edit them or use the CellStack/Cellerator CP-MATH ledger as BitOp state.
Never reset, clean, stash, rebase, switch branches, overwrite, or attribute unrelated dirty work. Recheck Git HEAD, worktrees, active claims, changes, guard, and audit at pickup and handoff.

Baseplane owns packed sequence representation, validity-aware low-level predicates, portable/prepared sequence programs, CPU/SIMD/CUDA execution, explicit residency, compact masks/events, generic segments, and scalar references. Cellerator owns the shared domain/order/identity/operand ABI, relation structures, runtime integration, numerical interpretation, fusion, planning, learned/mechanistic state, and partition policy. CelleraTorch is optional. CellShard remains read-only and parked.

Cellerator, CelleraTorch, CellShard, and CellStack are external to this Baseplane project root. Cellerator implementation ownership is represented only by external CE-ARCH checkpoint decisions; Baseplane tasks never duplicate or claim it. CellShard receives no work. Any future external task must inspect the owning ledger, AGENTS.md, Git state, claims, and leases and stop on overlap.

CELLERATOR-EXTERNAL-STATE is ready-with-mandatory-recheck because the observed CP-MATH-08A referee work landed and Cellerator implementation paths are Git-clean, but the user prohibited re-opening its todo ledger in this turn. Every external task must perform a read-only Git/session/claim/lease audit before editing, must never mutate Cellerator todo state, and must stop on any overlap.

Canonical C++/CUDA source is authoritative. Use cpp-context-compiler where configured; generated .ctxpp views are read-only. Fall back to focused canonical reads when semantic indexing is unavailable or owned by another session.

Preserve Baseplane::seq, dna2 naming, motif32_exact, scan_exact_count_cpu/cuda, scan_exact_emit_cpu/cuda, and the shifted packed exact scanner unless an explicitly approved interface revision proves a breaking need.

Keep two-bit canonical bases and add an optional one-bit validity sidecar. Chunk/contig origin is batch metadata; events use local uint32 positions where possible. Inactive tail bits and invalid bases must never create matches. BP-BITOP-10 must decide explicit chunk limits rather than casually widening every event.

Prefer an eight-byte core event compatible with motif_hit: uint32 local position, uint16 predicate ID, uint8 payload, uint8 flags. Scores/embeddings/segment offsets are sidecars. Distinguish logical produced, physical written, dropped, capacity required, and stable versus unordered order; never silently truncate.

Portable plans are bounded, pointer-free, relocatable, versioned, verifiable, deterministic, and backend-neutral. Prepared plans contain backend/device tuning, representation and scratch requirements, but no hidden allocations/transfers/synchronization. CPU executes every accepted v1 operation; CUDA initially lowers to specialized families, not a device VM.

Use ownership intervals plus bounded halos for local dependencies, compact continuation/finite-state summaries only for small regular state, and sparse Cellerator event/object routing for long range. Raw information communicates locally; compressed meaning communicates globally.
No hidden hot-path allocation, transfer, device choice, stream, synchronization, resident plane cache, or output materialization. Repeated prepared runs use caller-owned buffers and scratch.

CUDA work targets Volta sm_70 on Tesla V100 and CUDA 12.9. Use custom bitwise kernels only when semantics or measured traffic justify them. Benchmark, profiler, sanitizer, and all-GPU gates require their exclusive resources; source must never hardcode the assigned device.

Only the designated integrator may edit root CMakeLists.txt, public umbrella headers, package exports, central docs indices, common benchmark drivers, Cellerator shared registries, or CellStack pointers. Acquire the named lock and run guard/changes before the critical section.

Every worker uses a task-specific build directory build-bitop-<TASK-ID> and never shares mutable build output. CPU build capacity is four; GPU correctness can use assigned GPUs concurrently, but benchmark/profiler/sanitizer gates are serialized.

Stop and hand off/block with exact evidence on unidentified dirty owned files, overlapping live lease, missing/frozen-interface mismatch, checkpoint/base-HEAD drift, absent resource, ownership contradiction, stable exact API break, missing CPU oracle, occupied CMake seam, material plan/code divergence, contaminated benchmark, unexplained sanitizer finding, or optional branch without activation evidence.

Do not add sequence file parsers, genome/motif databases, IUPAC core parsing, PWM/ontology policy, AnnData/HDF5/CSPACK ownership, training/autograd in Baseplane, dense per-base embeddings, unrestricted GPU VM, NVRTC first path, dynamic parallelism, cooperative-grid baseline, Tensor Core Boolean claims, broad reorganization, or CP-BP matrix types.

Preserve packed exact XOR/OR/POPCOUNT; allowed matching derives A=~(lo|hi), C=lo&~hi, G=~lo&hi, T=lo&hi and counts active (~ok|~valid); boundary shifts load adjacent words without shift-by-32; reverse complement may use bit reversal plus complement after proof; stable emit is count-scan-emit; fast emit uses ballot/rank/block reservations; portable identity excludes live pointers and streams.

Measure packed direct versus resident planes, direct allowed masks versus capped exact expansion, four multi-motif mappings, current versus shuffle count reduction, event mask versus records by density, stable versus unordered output, halo versus continuation, and lowered CUDA versus interpreter. Graphs/persistent kernels/NVRTC/discrete-program learning remain post-evidence.
